# Country scope. True when bubble heat is dangerously elevated or sovereign leverage is strained.
oe_fin_bubble_distress = {
	OR = {
		is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		num_loans >= 5
		inflation >= 0.08
		AND = {
			num_loans >= 3
			inflation >= 0.05
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_bubble_heat }
			var:oe_fin_bubble_heat >= 60
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Speculative Bubble & Sovereign Debt Crash can cleanly conclude.
oe_fin_crash_resolved = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_fin_mod_modern_credit_order
		AND = {
			is_during_bankruptcy = no
			inflation < 0.05
			num_loans <= 2
			stability >= 20
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_stabilization_steps }
				var:oe_fin_stabilization_steps >= 2
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		AND = {
			has_variable = oe_fin_crash_months
			var:oe_fin_crash_months >= 96
			is_during_bankruptcy = no
			stability >= 10
		}
	}
}
